text: Unsafe code is narrow and marked with `unsafe`; Strict Carbon marks all of it, Permissive Carbon lets some C++ interop and migration code omit it, per file or function. Type safety at compile time, initialization hybrid, spatial at run time, temporal and data-race at compile time, largely matching Rust; unsynchronized temporal bugs must be prevented. Release keeps bounds checks, debug is fail-stop. Targets: under 1% temporal overhead (docs/design/safety/README.md, proposals/p005914-updating-carbon-s-safety-strategy.md).
